description: This file contains implementations of functions and classes related to batched tensor transformations, specifically for permuting batch dimensions, aligning batch dimensions for broadcasting, and converting between logical and physical tensor representations within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: VmapPhysicalView
classes.description: Represents a physical view of a tensor with batch dimensions permuted to the front, providing methods to query and manipulate physical and logical dimensions.

classes.name: VmapPhysicalToLogicalMap
classes.description: Provides a mapping from physical tensor views back to their logical (batched) tensor representations.

classes.name: MultiBatchVmapTransform
classes.description: Handles transforming multiple logical tensors into their physical representations, aligning batch dimensions for collective operations.

classes.name: BroadcastingVmapTransform
classes.description: Specialized for transforming two tensors for broadcasting, aligning batch and non-batch dimensions.

methods.name: logicalToPhysical
methods.description: Converts a logical tensor to its physical view with batch dims permuted to the front.

methods.name: getPhysicalDims
methods.description: Returns the physical dimensions corresponding to logical dimensions, optionally based on provided logical dims.

methods.name: getPhysicalDim
methods.description: Returns the physical dimension index for a given logical dimension.

methods.name: getPhysicalShape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the physical tensor corresponding to a logical shape.

methods.name: getPhysicalToLogicalMap
methods.description: Returns a map object that can convert physical tensors back to logical tensors.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the physical-to-logical mapping to a tensor, converting it back to its batched form.

methods.name: applyInplace
methods.description: In-place conversion of a list of physical tensors back to their logical form.
